create_SmoothedValue: create a SmoothedValue instance to track a rolling window of metric values with configurable window size
update_SmoothedValue: update a SmoothedValue instance with a new value to compute median, avg, and global_avg
create_MetricLogger: create a MetricLogger to track multiple named metrics using SmoothedValue meters with tab-delimited output
update_MetricLogger: update a MetricLogger with keyword arguments to log multiple metrics including torch.Tensor values
str_MetricLogger: print a MetricLogger to get a tab-delimited string of all tracked metrics with median and global average
